crossRefs.note: God’s sons saw that men’s daughters were beautiful, and they took any that they wanted for themselves as wives.
When Abram had come into Egypt, Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.
The princes of Pharaoh saw her, and praised her to Pharaoh; and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.
Jacob loved Rachel. He said, “I will serve you seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.”
His soul joined to Dinah, the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the young lady, and spoke kindly to the young lady.
Hamor talked with them, saying, “The soul of my son, Shechem, longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as a wife.
He came up, and told his father and his mother, saying, “I have seen a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the…
Then his father and his mother said to him, “Isn’t there a woman among your brothers’ daughters, or among all my…
Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.
Who can find a worthy woman? For her price is far above rubies.
Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears Yahweh, she shall be praised.
But all the girls, who have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.

translations.web: and see among the captives a beautiful woman, and you are attracted to her, and desire to take her as your wife,
translations.bsb: if you see a beautiful woman among them, and you desire her and want to take her as your wife,
translations.kjv: And seest among the captives a beautiful woman, and hast a desire unto her, that thou wouldest have her to thy wife;
translations.asv: and seest among the captives a beautiful woman, and thou hast a desire unto her, and wouldest take her to thee to wife;
